Case.title: AI Body Analyzer
Case.subtitle: Exploring how computer vision and language models can come together in a web application.
Case.disclaimer: The application is a fitness-oriented experiment, not a medical diagnostic tool.
Case.overviewText: The project README describes a photo-based body-analysis application combining pose estimation, heuristic measurements and AI-generated fitness feedback. The interface connects a Next.js frontend with a Python/FastAPI backend.
Case.f1desc: MediaPipe Pose detects 33 body landmarks in a supplied photo.
Case.f2desc: Gemini integration for reporting and a contextual assistant with streamed responses.
Case.f3desc: JWT-based sign-in, verification and user profiles.
Case.f4desc: Saved analyses and associated assistant conversations.
Case.contributionText: I worked hands-on with MediaPipe and prompts embedded in the code, manually tested the application and learned my way around its structure. AI tools supported other parts of development. This case study is about practical exploration and iteration, not a claim that I wrote every subsystem independently.
Case.limitationsText: The public README documents the features above; they have not all been independently verified for this portfolio. The live deployment is currently offline, so the repository is the primary reference. Results from 2D photographs can be imprecise and should not be used for medical decisions.
Case.repoReadme: Features and technology descriptions are based on the public repository README.
